observations: White chest freezer with a stainless steel lid and handle.
A 'MAGNITY' brand sticker is visible on the top left of the lid.
A '3 YEARS' warranty sticker is on the front, but it is partially obscured by a watermark.
The unit has a control panel with a dial and two indicator lights on the front right.
The rear right side shows a cooling fan grille.
The exterior surface of the unit appears dusty or dirty.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not visible on the sticker or the unit.
Requires a technical specification sheet or a video of the unit plugged in.
The warranty sticker in photo 0 explicitly states this.
The unit is shown in a dusty environment, and the cooling fan is not visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The compressor may be faulty or the unit may not cool.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on and reaching a freezing temperature.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity may be significantly less than 250 liters.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior with the lid open.

risks.risk: The unit may be missing the power cord or the plug.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the unit showing the power cord and plug.

proof_requests: Photo of the interior of the freezer with the lid open.
Photo of the manufacturer's technical specification plate (usually on the back or inside).
Video of the freezer running and cooling.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the sticker. The item can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until further proof is provided.
